# extract


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

Search finds documents; this page is about what is in them. A doctype is
the kind of document: an invoice, a receipt, a contract, a paper,
meeting notes, a passport, and 31 types in all. It is separate from a
document’s `kind`, which records how the document arrived (`web`, `pdf`,
`note` and so on). The doctype decides which schema `extract` uses, that
is which fields it asks a model for (an invoice has a number, a vendor,
a total and line items), and which shelf `reshelf` moves the document
to.

[varga](https://vedicreader.github.io/varga/) holds the cue table that
recognises each doctype, the schemas, and the code that makes a model
answer in a schema’s shape. This page stores varga’s verdicts in the
vault and runs extraction through the vault’s model and its privacy
checks.

`categorize` decides a document’s doctype and writes it into the
document’s `meta`. It first scores the document against varga’s cue
table: phrases such as “invoice no” or “total due”, amounts of money,
dates, organisation names. `score` is the winning type’s score and
`decisive` says whether it beat the runner-up clearly. Only when the
cues are not decisive does it ask a model. With `llm='auto'`, the
default, a local model is asked only if it is already downloaded, so
categorising never starts a download; `llm='always'` asks a model every
time and `llm='never'` never does. The model gets the document’s title
and its text through `send_check`, so a private document’s title and
text reach a hosted model masked or not at all. A file read off disk is
judged on its name as well as its text. `by` says how the verdict was
reached.

A verdict the cues reached decisively, or one a model gave, is written
as `doctype`. An undecided one that scores at least `REVIEW_SCORE` (0.2)
is only proposed, in `doctype_proposed`, for a person to confirm:
`proposed_types` lists the proposals, surest first, and `accept_type`,
`accept_types` and `reject_type` settle them. This is the same two-step
review that `suggest_noisy` and `accept_noisy` use for noise. Below 0.2
nothing is written, and `reshelf` never moves a document on a proposal.
`categorize_all` types every untyped document on the shelf.

## Extraction

`extract` reads a whole document, up to `max_chars`, and returns its
fields as a dict. Without a `schema` it categorises the document first
and takes its doctype’s schema: an invoice gets `Invoice`, and a doctype
with no schema of its own gets `Summary`. A schema can also be a
`SCHEMAS` key, a dataclass, or a string such as
`'vendor:str, total:float'`. The model is made to answer in the schema’s
shape with a tool call, a grammar or parsed JSON, whichever its backend
supports. `check=True` reads every value back through `check_fields` and
lists what did not fit in `errors`. `src` gives the page and block each
field was read from, and `cite=True` adds the quote.
`extract_all(doctype='invoice')` runs over every invoice and returns one
row per document.

Privacy works as in `ask`, with `pii='local'` as the default here. The
decision is `send_check`’s. A private document is read by the local
`pii_model` or by nothing, `redact` masks its title, source and text for
a hosted model, and `refuse` reads nothing. A Local only document goes
to no hosted model under any policy, `off` included. A model on this
machine reads the document whole. Each hosted send is written to the
send log. Fields read from a private document are scanned and masked
before they are returned or saved.

### Vault.extract

``` python
def extract(
    ref:str, # doc_id, source, title substring, or a path on disk
    schema:NoneType=None, # a SCHEMAS key, a dataclass, or a 'field:type, …' spec; None -> from the doctype
    model:str=None, # an id, a path, `mlx/…`; None -> $VISHALAKSHI_MODEL
    chat_kw:dict=None, # anything else Urai's `Chat` takes: temp, runtime, think, …
    max_chars:int=8000, # chars of the document the model sees
    sp:str='You pull structured fields out of one document.\n\nRules:\n- Copy what the document states. Do not compute, convert, round or tidy a value.\n- A field the document does not state stays empty. An invented number is worse than a blank one.\n- Numbers are bare: 1240.50, not "$1,240.50". The currency belongs in its own field.\n- Dates are ISO: 2024-03-01.\n- A list field takes every entry the document has, in the order it has them.', # system prompt for the extraction
    save:bool=False, # write the fields into the document's meta
    llm:str='auto', # the LLM leg of the categorisation, when picking the schema
    pii:str='local', # local|redact|refuse|off, as in `ask`; a Local only document reaches no hosted model even under `off`
    pii_model:str=None, # local model when private; None -> $VISHALAKSHI_PII_MODEL
    check:bool=True, # read the values back through `check_fields` and report what did not
    cite:bool=False, # ask for the quote each value was read from; `src` carries it
)->fastcore.basics.AttrDict:
```

*Pull structured fields out of one document, such as an invoice’s
number, vendor and totals, in the shape of a schema.*

## Asking about one whole document

`ask_doc(ref, question)` is `ask` with `ref=`: the document is section
\[1\], whole up to `max_chars`, and `related` sections from the rest of
the vault follow it. `schema=` returns the answer as fields instead of
prose. The privacy rules are `ask`’s.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/vedicreader/vishalakshi/blob/main/vishalakshi/extract.py#L296"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### Vault.ask_doc

``` python
def ask_doc(
    ref:str, # doc_id, source, title substring, or a path on disk
    question:str, # what you want to know about it
    schema:NoneType=None, # answer as this shape instead of prose
    max_chars:int=8000, # chars of the document the model sees
    related:int=3, # sections from the *rest* of the vault to add as context
    **kw
)->fastcore.basics.AttrDict: # forwarded to `ask` (model=, chat_kw=, sp=)
```

*Answer a question about one whole document: `ask` with that document as
section \[1\].*

## Try it

The cue table recognises these two documents without a model, and the
schemas say which fields each one would give.

``` python
from vishalakshi import Vault

INVOICE = '''# INVOICE

Invoice No: ACM-2024-0117
Date: 2024-03-01
Payment terms: Net 30

Bill to: Contoso GmbH, Berlin
From: Acme Supplies Ltd

## Line items

| Description | Qty | Unit price | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Widget, steel | 12 | $8.50 | $102.00 |
| Gasket, nitrile | 40 | $1.20 | $48.00 |

Subtotal: $150.00
VAT (20%): $30.00
Total due: $180.00
'''

CATALOGUE = '''# Spring price list

## Widget, steel

SKU: WS-100. Price: $8.50 per unit. In stock.
Specifications: 40mm, zinc plated. Dimensions 40x12x4mm.

## Gasket, nitrile

SKU: GN-220. Price: $1.20 per unit. Out of stock.
Add to cart to be notified.
'''

v = Vault(':memory:')
v.add(INVOICE, 'Acme invoice ACM-2024-0117', source='/inbox/acme-0117.md')
v.add(CATALOGUE, 'Spring price list', source='/inbox/spring-list.md')
v.doctypes()
```

    {'untyped': 2}

``` python
r = v.categorize('Acme invoice ACM-2024-0117', llm='never')
r.doctype, r.score, r.decisive, r.by
```

    ('invoice', 1.0, True, 'cues (ner+regex)')

``` python
test_eq(r.doctype, 'invoice')
assert r.decisive, r.scores          # the cues are sure enough that no model is needed
test_eq(v.doc(r.doc_id)['meta']['doctype'], 'invoice')   # written back into the vault
test_eq(v.categorize('Spring price list', llm='never').doctype, 'catalogue')
test_eq(v.doctypes(), {'invoice': 1, 'catalogue': 1})
test_eq(v.of_type('invoice').attrgot('title'), ['Acme invoice ACM-2024-0117'])
```

The cells above need no model and no API key. When the cues cannot
decide, or a nested field such as an invoice’s line items needs a bigger
model, pass `model=` and `chat_kw=` as you would to `ask`. The hidden
cells below replay answers recorded from a local model, and `evals/` has
the measurements.
